notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard library, and adapter-supplied application FOM, standard MIM, provider package, endpoint, and callback configuration. It subscribes to standard HLAreportException, triggers a typed NameNotFound with an undefined object-class lookup, toggles Exception Reporting through standard HLAsetSwitches, and verifies enabled delivery, disabled suppression, reliable RTI-originated callback metadata, the textual service/exception parameters, and the reported federate handle. It uses no provider-specific name, registry, header, or internal state.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador standard-MIM lookup, subscription, receive-order failure reporting, callback service, and lifecycle; FederateAmbassador.receiveInteraction report observation
api_surfaces.source_symbol: RTIambassador::getInteractionClassHandle, RTIambassador::getParameterHandle, RTIambassador::getTransportationTypeHandle, RTIambassador::getFederateHandle, RTIambassador::subscribeInteractionClass, RTIambassador::getObjectClassHandle, RTIambassador::getExceptionReportingSwitch, RTIambassador::sendInteraction, RTIambassador::evokeCallback, FederateAmbassador::receiveInteraction
